dedupe_keys.name: models for validation of a naturally ventilated single story double skin facade in whole building energy simulation tools

description: Elena Catto Lucchino and colleagues publish model packages for comparing naturally ventilated single-storey double-skin façades in EnergyPlus, TRNSYS, IDA ICE and IES-VE. The native description describes three ventilation modes and comparison with measured thermophysical quantities. Five RAR descriptors separate the four tool packages and weather files. Zenodo offers the building-energy simulation collection freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a single-storey façade experiment; observation dates, exact model versions and site are not fully specified here. The linked experimental-data deposit remains separately held because of possible overlap with existing TWINS observations. This model record does not claim a new independent measurement dataset. The source reports that accuracy varies by variable and ventilation mode. The related flexible IDA ICE model addresses a different modelling configuration. No model archive was opened and the reported performance was not independently reproduced.
